preliminary_runs.client-validation: Port collision during harness validation; no valid performance result. Occupied-port and process locking guards added.
preliminary_runs.client-validation-v2: Validated streaming, timing fields and three input lengths. Preliminary only, during compiler activity.
preliminary_runs.ollama-current-compatibility: Interrupted initial import during client validation. Superseded by compatibility-v2 and the CUDA-specific check.
preliminary_runs.ollama-current-compatibility-v2: Established official current Ollama can load on Vulkan. Preliminary timing only; not a final performance comparison.
preliminary_runs.ollama-cuda-check: Current official CUDA-only attempt fell back to CPU and was rejected. Ollama 0.11.10 loaded all layers using CUDA. Preliminary timings during compilation.
preliminary_runs.placement-screen: 26 configurations screened. Row splitting failed model load on both stock revisions. Alternating two prompts allowed current Ollama to reuse whole prefixes; its timings must not be treated as fresh-prefill measurements. Used to establish compatibility; stock dual placement screens informed selection alongside a new NCCL screen.
preliminary_runs.workloads: Initial two-variant fixtures. Superseded after multiple-prefix caching was identified.
preliminary_runs.workloads-v2: Rejected numeric IDs before final measurements: numeric token merges did not preserve identifier lengths.
preliminary_runs.workloads-v3: Delimited unique IDs verified: 1000 labels have 11 tokens, and first 24 full prompts have exactly 512, 2048 and 8192 tokens. Used for the final campaign.

scope: No final comparative speed claims are drawn from preliminary timing runs. Preserve failures and superseded evidence.
